C1490.title: Am I Eclipsed? A Smart Detector of Eclipse Attacks for Ethereum
C1490.summary: This study proposes a smart detector for eclipse attacks on Ethereum. An attacker can control a target node's peer connections, isolate it from the normal network, and present a manipulated blockchain view. The paper analyzes Ethereum connection and message-interaction features and constructs a method for recognizing abnormal isolation, helping node operators determine whether an eclipse attack is disrupting transaction and consensus decisions.
